tasks.title: Setup Next.js Project with TypeScript
tasks.description: Initialize the project with Next.js 13+ and TypeScript, configure Tailwind CSS with CSS Modules, and set up the basic project structure.
tasks.details:
1. Create a new Next.js project with TypeScript support:
```bash
npx create-next-app@latest running-crews --typescript
```
2. Install and configure Tailwind CSS with CSS Modules:
```bash
npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer
npx tailwindcss init -p
```
3. Configure Tailwind CSS in `tailwind.config.js`
4. Set up folder structure for the app router:
   - `/app`: Main application routes
   - `/components`: Reusable UI components
   - `/lib`: Utility functions and helpers
   - `/public`: Static assets
   - `/styles`: Global styles
5. Configure environment variables and `.env` files
6. Set up basic layout components (header, footer, main layout)
7. Configure TypeScript settings in `tsconfig.json`
8. Set up Vercel deployment configuration
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify project builds without errors
2. Confirm TypeScript compilation works
3. Test that Tailwind CSS is properly configured
4. Ensure the development server runs correctly
5. Validate the project structure follows Next.js 13+ best practices
6. Test basic navigation between pages

tasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Bug Tracking and Resolution System
tasks.description: Create an integrated bug tracking and resolution system that works with existing documentation, automates detection, and builds a knowledge base to prevent recurring issues.
tasks.details:
1. Set up a centralized bug tracking database:
   - Use a NoSQL database (e.g., MongoDB) to store bug reports, their status, and related information.
   - Create schemas for bug reports, including fields like id, title, description, severity, status, assignee, created_at, updated_at, and resolution.

2. Develop API endpoints for bug management:
   - Create RESTful API routes in `/app/api/bugs/` for CRUD operations on bug reports.
   - Implement authentication and authorization for these endpoints.

3. Create UI components for bug reporting and viewing:
   - Develop a BugReportForm component in `/components/bugs/BugReportForm.tsx`.
   - Create a BugList component in `/components/bugs/BugList.tsx` for displaying and filtering bugs.
   - Implement a BugDetails component in `/components/bugs/BugDetails.tsx` for viewing and updating individual bug reports.

4. Integrate with existing documentation:
   - Parse BUGREPORT.md, SECURITY_FIXES.md, STATISTICS_ISSUES_FIXED.md, and STATISTICS_DISCREPANCY_RESOLUTION.md to import existing bug data.
   - Develop a script to keep these files in sync with the new bug database.

5. Implement automated bug detection:
   - Set up error logging and monitoring using a service like Sentry or LogRocket.
   - Create a system to automatically generate bug reports from logged errors.

6. Develop resolution documentation templates:
   - Create standardized templates for bug resolution documentation.
   - Implement a system to automatically generate initial documentation based on bug report data.

7. Build a knowledge base system:
   - Develop a tagging system for categorizing bugs and their solutions.
   - Create a search functionality to easily find similar past issues.
   - Implement a suggestion system that recommends potential solutions based on similar past bugs.

8. Integrate with development workflow:
   - Set up webhooks to connect the bug tracking system with GitHub (or your VCS).
   - Automatically update bug statuses based on commit messages or pull request activities.
   - Implement a system to link bugs with related code changes.

9. Create analytics and reporting features:
   - Develop dashboards for visualizing bug trends, resolution times, and other key metrics.
   - Implement automated report generation for weekly/monthly bug status updates.

10. Ensure security and data protection:
    - Implement proper access controls and data encryption for sensitive bug information.
    - Set up regular backups of the bug database.

11. Provide user training and documentation:
    - Create user guides for different roles (developers, QA, project managers) on how to use the new system.
    - Conduct training sessions for team members on effective use of the bug tracking and resolution system.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit Testing:
   - Write unit tests for all API endpoints related to bug management.
   - Create unit tests for utility functions used in bug processing and analysis.

2. Integration Testing:
   - Test the integration between the bug database and the API layer.
   - Verify correct interaction between the bug tracking system and version control webhooks.

3. UI Testing:
   - Conduct thorough testing of all bug reporting, viewing, and management UI components.
   - Test responsiveness and usability across different devices and screen sizes.

4. Automated Bug Detection Testing:
   - Simulate various error scenarios to verify that the automated bug detection system correctly logs and reports issues.

5. Documentation Integration Testing:
   - Verify that existing documentation (BUGREPORT.md, etc.) is correctly parsed and imported.
   - Test the synchronization between the bug database and markdown files.

6. Knowledge Base Testing:
   - Test the accuracy of the tagging system for categorizing bugs.
   - Verify the effectiveness of the search functionality in finding similar past issues.
   - Test the suggestion system with various bug scenarios to ensure relevant solutions are recommended.

7. Workflow Integration Testing:
   - Verify that bug statuses are correctly updated based on VCS activities.
   - Test the linking between bugs and related code changes.

8. Security Testing:
   - Conduct penetration testing on the bug tracking system to ensure data security.
   - Verify that access controls are working as expected for different user roles.

9. Performance Testing:
   - Test the system's performance under high load (e.g., many simultaneous bug reports or queries).
   - Verify that the analytics and reporting features can handle large datasets efficiently.

10. User Acceptance Testing:
    - Conduct UAT with different user groups (developers, QA, project managers) to ensure the system meets their needs.
    - Gather feedback on the usability and effectiveness of the new bug tracking and resolution system.

11. Backup and Recovery Testing:
    - Test the backup process for the bug database.
    - Conduct recovery drills to ensure data can be successfully restored from backups.

12. Compatibility Testing:
    - Verify that the bug tracking system works correctly across different browsers and operating systems.

13. Accessibility Testing:
    - Ensure that the bug tracking interface is accessible and complies with WCAG guidelines.

subtasks.description: Implement a NoSQL database system to store and manage bug reports and related information.
subtasks.details: Use MongoDB to create a database with schemas for bug reports, including fields like id, title, description, severity, status, assignee, created_at, updated_at, and resolution.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify database connection, schema validation, and basic CRUD operations on bug reports.

subtasks.title: Develop API endpoints for bug management
subtasks.description: Create RESTful API routes for CRUD operations on bug reports with proper authentication and authorization.
subtasks.details: Implement API routes in /app/api/bugs/ for creating, reading, updating, and deleting bug reports. Ensure proper authentication and authorization mechanisms are in place.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use Postman or similar tool to test all API endpoints for correct functionality and security.

subtasks.title: Create UI components for bug reporting and viewing
subtasks.description: Develop React components for bug reporting, listing, and detailed view.
subtasks.details: Create BugReportForm, BugList, and BugDetails components in the /components/bugs/ directory. Ensure these components interact correctly with the API endpoints.
subtasks.testStrategy: Conduct unit tests for each component and integration tests for component interactions.

subtasks.title: Integrate with existing documentation
subtasks.description: Parse existing markdown files and import data into the new bug database.
subtasks.details: Develop scripts to parse BUGREPORT.md, SECURITY_FIXES.md, STATISTICS_ISSUES_FIXED.md, and STATISTICS_DISCREPANCY_RESOLUTION.md. Import the data into the MongoDB database and create a system to keep these files in sync with the database.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify correct parsing of all markdown files and accurate data import into the database.

subtasks.title: Implement automated bug detection
subtasks.description: Set up error logging and monitoring with automatic bug report generation.
subtasks.details: Integrate a service like Sentry or LogRocket for error logging. Develop a system that automatically generates bug reports in the database from logged errors.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate various error scenarios and verify automatic creation of corresponding bug reports.

subtasks.title: Develop resolution documentation templates
subtasks.description: Create standardized templates for bug resolution documentation with auto-generation capabilities.
subtasks.details: Design and implement standardized templates for bug resolution documentation. Create a system that automatically generates initial documentation based on the data in bug reports.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test the auto-generation of documentation for various types of bug reports and verify template adherence.

subtasks.title: Build a knowledge base system
subtasks.description: Implement a tagging system, search functionality, and solution suggestion mechanism for bugs.
subtasks.details: Develop a tagging system for categorizing bugs and solutions. Implement robust search functionality and a system that suggests potential solutions based on similar past bugs.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test the accuracy of the tagging system, search functionality, and solution suggestions with a diverse set of bug scenarios.

subtasks.title: Integrate with development workflow
subtasks.description: Connect the bug tracking system with version control and implement automated status updates.
subtasks.details: Set up webhooks to connect the bug tracking system with GitHub. Implement automatic bug status updates based on commit messages or pull request activities. Create a system to link bugs with related code changes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate various Git activities and verify correct automatic updates in the bug tracking system.
